title: anamnesis-rights/v1
description: The permission basis and disclosure class that control whether a source may be preserved and what may be released from it. Public visibility is not a rights basis. The validator in skills/anamnesis/scripts/anamnesis.py is the executable authority; this file declares the same closed shape for a reader.

basis.description: How preservation is permitted. 'licence' names an open licence in the source itself. 'permission' names a written grant. 'contract' names an agreement. 'digest-only' permits an identifier and a hash while refusing the bytes.

disclosure.description: What may leave the corpus. 'public' admits derived text. 'restricted' admits identifiers and digests alone. 'embargoed' is refused at admission.

holder.description: The party whose permission this basis records.

statement.description: The exact recorded claim: a licence identifier, or the text of the grant relied on.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 date after which the basis is no longer relied on, or absent when it does not expire. Absent is not 'never'; it means the source did not establish one.
